hero.bio: Engineer. I like <accent>efficient solutions to hard problems</accent>, and interfaces that feel good to use.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A few things I built because the problem was interesting.

items.crimp-studio: Climbing wall route setter with draggable 3D holds, procedural route generation and undo/redo history.
items.coast-to-cup: Which 2026 World Cup group has the worst logistics: travel, circadian shift, altitude and heat, modelled against a base camp.
items.hiit-maker: Interval training builder, rebuilt on Vite and React 19 as an offline-installable PWA with a gym mode.
items.vscodethemes-scrapper: Scrapes the VS Code themes marketplace into a database, then classifies the themes.
items.arkham-theme: A VS Code dark theme based on Transylvania and Mayukai.
items.pixel-algorithms: Grid algorithms you can scrub through: A*, flood fill, Bresenham, dithering, marching squares.
items.claude-checkpoint-diagram: Claude Code plugin that draws a Mermaid checkpoint diagram at each pause in a run.
items.claude-doc-tdd: Claude Code plugin. TDD for facts: an executable check per claim before anything is published.
items.trilha-agentica: A practical agentic engineering track in Portuguese: skills, hooks, subagents, MCP.

projects.claudeIntro: Plugins and skills I use every day.
